THE SPARK

Why this one?

I wanted a companion that could understand something directly in front of us, not just respond to a typed question. TIKI began with a simple idea: what if you could point to something and ask about it?

THE BUILD

How it works

TIKI is a smart-glasses proof of concept built around an ESP32-S3 camera. The physical button captures photos, a Mac runs the AI and voice processing, and an attached speaker plays responses. Captures and descriptions can be saved to a local visual-memory library.

ESP32-S3 · Camera · FastAPI · Gemini · SQLite · I²S audio

THE COMPONENTS

Inside the project

  • Button-activated photo capture
  • AI visual descriptions and voice response
  • Locally saved pictures and searchable descriptions

CURRENT CHAPTER

Progress & evidence

The repository includes a real hardware demo, photographed prototype, firmware and a documented local setup.

Working hardware MVP. The Mac handles microphone input and processing; it is not yet a standalone wearable.
